title: Three Weeks and One Short Bag
subtitle: 垃圾处理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 垃圾处理（人与自然·环境保护·废物与处理）
meta: 主题语境：垃圾处理（人与自然·环境保护·废物与处理）　|　核心词汇：litter　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 litter 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1994 the sweeper ① cleared the litter that no neighbour in the lane would have recorded, and he said the clearing was the whole of the week. The ② litter, meaning the waste itself and not the bag, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; litter, he said, is the only thing in a lane that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ piece of litter in that lane had the same short bag beside it, and the ④ litter at the far corner, meaning the can they kept for the children to clear and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Litter, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the sweeper said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the litter was the whole of the matter, meaning the mess and not the waste. The ⑥ litter, meaning the mess and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; litter, he said, is either something you clear or the only word that means both waste and a mess. He said the mess is the part they remember.

By 1999 the ⑦ litter had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short bag. The ⑧ litter of the whole thing, the sweeper wrote in May, was one lane and three weeks of recording; litter, he said, is either the can at the far corner or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ litter I remember is the litter recorded in the report, which closed in 2001 and is still recorded as the quietest in the lane. ⑩ Litter, my mother said in 2003, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all litter, she said, is a mess that has agreed to look like waste. She said the mess was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 垃圾；废弃物（指小巷里每一片旁边的那一片）
B. n. 垃圾；废弃物（指那片废弃物本身，与垃圾袋相对）
C. 固定搭配：clear the litter 清扫这一片垃圾
D. n. 垃圾；废弃物（指留给孩子们清的那一罐那一片）
E. n. 清扫之事（抽象总称，指一处小巷的垃圾之事）
F. n. 垃圾；废弃物（指环卫记录里写到、被记载的的那一片）
G. n. 脏乱、陋习（指一件事里人人都扫却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 陋习（抽象总称，指人人都扫却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cleared the litter that no neighbour in the lane would have recorded
The litter, meaning the waste itself and not the bag
Every piece of litter in that lane
the litter at the far corner
the litter was the whole of the matter
the litter had become a line in a report
The litter of the whole thing

answers.why: clear the litter 意为“清扫这一片垃圾”，1994 年那位保洁员把小巷里没有一位邻居肯记载的一片垃圾做了一遍。
litter 意为“垃圾；废弃物”，指那片废弃物本身而不是垃圾袋，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。
litter 意为“垃圾；废弃物”，指小巷里每一片旁边的那一片，每一片旁边都有同一只小小的垃圾袋。
litter 意为“垃圾；废弃物”，指最远那处巷角留给孩子们清的那一罐那一片，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
litter 意为“脏乱、陋习”，指一件事里人人都扫却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份脏乱就是那件事的全部。
litter 意为“陋习”，指人人都扫却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片废弃物，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
litter 意为“垃圾；废弃物”，指环卫记录里写到、被记载的的那一片，到 1999 年这一片成了环卫记录里的一行。
litter 意为“清扫之事”，保洁员五月写道，整件事的垃圾之事是一处小巷和三个星期的记载。
litter 意为“垃圾；废弃物”，我记得的是环卫记录里记载过的那一片，2001 年清完了，至今仍被说成小巷里最安静的一片。
litter 为抽象总称，母亲 2003 年说，垃圾是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的废弃物。

那处小巷里每一片垃圾旁边都有同一只小小的垃圾袋。（litter）
